repo_notes.content: React Native library @enavermate/react-native-splitflap (repository name react-native-splitflap). New Architecture (Fabric) only. A pure TypeScript planner computes each cell's path and timing; two native players replay the plan: iOS with Core Animation (ios/), Android with a frame-driven Canvas (android/), shared Fabric shadow node in cpp/. The codegen spec is src/SplitflapViewNativeComponent.ts. lib/ is compiled build output (lib/module JS, lib/typescript .d.ts): document the API from README.md and the .d.ts types, never describe lib/module as source. There is no example app in this repository; master receives one commit per release. README.md is the authoritative API reference.
